mapper.select: select COUNT(CASE WHEN t.last_login_device = 'H5' THEN 1 END) AS h5VisitsNo, COUNT(CASE WHEN t.last_login_device = 'App' THEN 1 END) AS appRegisterNo from user_info t where t.delete_flag = 'NOT_DELETE' and (t.last_login_device is not null and t.last_login_device <> '') and t.create_time between #{beginTime} and #{endTime}
